finding: The Mi9 and T4 GABA kernels execute target[row] += ... and receive rate as const; they do not write rate. The v1 static map counted them as target+rate set writers, so its rate and final-writer-pair counts cannot be interpreted. Multiple target touches do not imply earlier additive contributions were erased.
repair: Prospective v2 reclassifies set/add/transform and counts only genuine rate writes; the original result remains unchanged.
